execution: Atlas; arithmetic jobs pinned to one core each, at most five concurrently. No research .deps directory.

catalogue.mode: integrity, induced support, exact local completion, reconstructed counts and coefficient queries
catalogue.note: Completed across two invocations with shared resource cache. Early entries query (0,0,0) and final indices; resumed entries query first and final terms at the final matrix entry. Cached support audits are shared within an invocation.

scope: Exact reduction replay is relative to the documented CW/group/composition identities and published primitive schemes; no proof-assistant formalization or dense expansion of target tensors.

explicit_schemes.mode: cwschemes verify <n> --exact: random evaluation mod 2^31-1 and all n^6 coefficients modulo CRT primes (exact over Q)
explicit_schemes.independent_gpu_check: all coefficients of 14, 16, 32 also certified by an independent int8 tensor-core checker (8 primes, CRT bound) before inclusion
explicit_schemes.negative_control: one perturbed coefficient makes both checks fail

z4_quotient_schemes.verify_exact: cwschemes verify <n> --exact passed for all 20 entries on atlas (relation replay exactly over Q at every q used; about 500 s per q on one core)
z4_quotient_schemes.port_faithfulness: q=2: all 12,185,088 coefficients equal to the research generator; q=3, 8, 17: 3,000 random coefficients each, no mismatch
z4_quotient_schemes.all_coefficients_q2: exact over Q (7 primes near 2^20, CRT bound 2^135.6)
z4_quotient_schemes.negative_controls: perturbed packet value, tensor value and factor coefficient: every check fails
z4_quotient_schemes.tests: pytest: 9 passed (includes an exact q=2 Z4 test)
